'''Harmen J. Bussemaker''' (born 1968, [[Hengelo]])<ref>[https://www.gf.org/fellows/all-fellows/harmen-j-bussemaker/ Biography] at the John Simon Guggenheim foundation website.</ref> is a Dutch and American biological [[physicist]], professor at [[Columbia University]],<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.columbia.edu/cu/biology/faculty-data/harmen-bussemaker/faculty.html|title=Bussemaker &#124; Columbia University : Biological Sciences}}</ref> and principal investigator of the Harmen Bussemaker lab.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.columbiauniversity.org/cu/biology/faculty-data/harmen-bussemaker/lab.html|title=columbiauniversity.org|website=www.columbiauniversity.org}}</ref>
